title: ticfac sandbox image needs ticfac's source tree, so the container's declared-image check is always skipped
description:
internal/cli/sandbox.go:114-123 resolves the default tk version with sandboximage.PinnedTkVersion(), which walks up from the cwd to a go.mod and reads image/Dockerfile. It does this even under --declared-only. In a worker container there is no ticfac checkout, so the verb exits 1. image/common.sh:1056 swallows the failure (|| declared=""), and check_declared_image never refuses a mismatched image. Reproduced: a repo declaring [sandbox] image, `ticfac sandbox image --declared-only --root <repo>` run from outside the module gives exit 1 'no go.mod above'. Fix: read the pin from the embedded image/ FS, or skip version resolution under --declared-only, and add a test run outside the module root.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding b4f826681c8bcbf6d6ee88a69a5c73a0f3f898024d36f2aa24f7e02d3e30964f (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-tdu/attempt-7): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/b4f826681c8bcbf6d6ee88a69a5c73a0f3f898024d36f2aa24f7e02d3e30964f.json on the run branch.
